City of Inglewood
  Finance Department
  (310) 412-5257

  MINUTES
  CLAIMS REVIEW COMMITTEE
  March 23, 2020

A meeting of the Claims Review Committee was held in the small Executive Conference
Room on the 9th floor at 11:32 a.m.:

  Members Present: Maria Heaney, Finance Department
  Debbie Crenshaw, City Treasurer
  Aisha Thompson, City Clerk

  Staff Present:  Sabrina Barnes – Parks and Recreation
  Cliff Plate- Fleet Services
  Ramon Quinones – Administration/Council
  Juan Mata – Parks and Recreation

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
  Maria Heaney reported no public comments.

1. The minutes of March 02, 2020, meeting was approved as recorded.

  2. Wanna Play - Executive session to discuss recommended payment for the services
  provided at the 6th Annual District 2 Potluck Picnic and Chili Cook off in the amount of
  $450.00. Motion carried unanimously.

  3. Natural Gas Systems, Inc. – Executive session to discuss recommended payment for
  services in repairing the City Natural Gas pumps in the amount of $750.00. Motion
  carried unanimously.

  4. RJM Design Group Inc – Executive session to discuss recommended payment for
  architectural services for North Park in the amount of $2,913.25. Motion carried
  unanimously.

  5. Aqua-Flo Supply – Executive session to discuss recommended payment for the
  purchase of valve assemblies in the amount of $817.84. Motion carried unanimously.

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
  Maria Heaney reported no public comments. There being no further business, the meeting
  adjourned at 11:45 a.m. Adjournment
